Obviously, you are not forced into the routine, you have got to be motivated and have some goals to apply this app. If you have a chaotic routine, use this app.

text: Works well.
author: Ronald Kaine

text: Great app for those of us with ADHD and time blindness! Having the routine steps planned out with time limits helps so much. I actually jump straight out of bed instead of procrastinating. The alarm pesters me and I just think "ah I'll get this done then I can go back to sleep" but I don't - I suddenly have motivation to go on with my tasks that day. I am feeling so much better with this extra control and reliability. I very much recommend this app :))

text: This app is exactly what it needs to be to help ADHD ppl with daily tasks. There's no overwhelming long lists to stress you out - you start a routine, and you see the step you are currently on, & the next step. That's it. The app encourages you to experiment to find what works - not to beat yourself up for not keeping to a strict timetable. I love the 'insights' tab - allows you to see how much time you actually needed for a task, when you actually start a routine, etc. so you can make changes.
author: Pawprints System

text: this app changed my productivity completely. when I am doing a routine, I am on task, and not doing anything else. it used to take me forever to get ready in the morning as I would constantly get distracted, but now I make a game out of it, if I can finish the task before the timer. I like that I can change the colours so I don't get bored of the app, (I would suggest more colours ;). other than that the app works smoothly and I would suggest this to anyone, even if you don't have adhd👍👍
author: Ellie Maung

text: It's the best I've seen for putting together routines. It doesn't do everything, which is a good thing, because it means that it has a singleness of purpose and doesn't overcomplicate the experience. One thing I would like to see in future is some way of integrating it with other tools. Because it doesn't do everything, I need to use other tools in my day-to-day productivity. Calendar syncing would be an obvious one, but also having an API would help advanced users create their own integrations

I get better results just using my default calendar phone app. And it's free!! At least the notifications go off when they are meant to. Remove the "ADHD" label from the app name. It's false advertising.

text: 最近、サブスクのアプリ多すぎるよな。ADHD 向けを謳うアプリとかルーティン系がサブスクなのは少し思うところがあるけど、保守管理業務考えたら仕方ないのかな。 サブスクしんどいな、と思いつつ、それでも使いやすさはほかアプリと比べて一番いい。 モーニングルーティン用で使ってます。 　まず、朝起きてスマホ触るとアプリのルーティン画面が開かれてて、そのままルーティンワークに入れる。 BGMも当たり障りがなくて良い。いらない時はOFFにできる。 でなんたって見やすい。UI/UXは考えられてる。 ウィジェット機能もある。 しっかり習慣づけできて、生活が改善されているのがわかる。ハードウェアではなくソフトウェアだけでこんなに人間が変われるのは感動です。 オススメのアプリ
